types.description: S202M-C20 miniature circuit breaker / two poles / C curve / 20 A

document.title: System pro M compact — DIN Rail components for low voltage installation

modelingNotes: Exact order row identifies S202M-C20, two protected poles, C characteristic, 20 A (S1, printed 2/38).

S1 S202 family wiring diagram (11/2), visually reviewed, marks 1–2 and 3–4 with mechanical coupling. Open denotes the depicted OFF state, not an installed operating state; contact metadata does not create net continuity or simulate protection.

Twin conductor/busbar terminal entries are represented by their common marked terminal with shared connection policy. No invented aperture numbers, phase assignments or neutral designation. Supply direction is not enforced.
Base breaker only: optional auxiliary/signal contacts, shunt trip, undervoltage release and motor operator are separately combined equipment; their connections are excluded.
IEC/EN 60898-1: 400 V AC, 50/60 Hz, Icn 10 kA, C-curve reference temperature 30 °C.

IEC/EN 60947-2: rated operational voltage 440 V AC; Icu 15 kA; Ics 11.2 kA for rated currents up to 40 A; C-curve reference temperature 55 °C. Conditional ratings are notes, not a scalar breaking capacity or assigned supply voltage.

Terminal current 20 A is the device rating, not conductor ampacity. No universal connection requirement is asserted for these application-dependent passive switching terminals. DC use, conductor sizing and coordination are not evaluated.

connectionCoverage.notes: All four manufacturer-marked base-breaker electrical terminals 1, 2, 3, 4 are represented. Twin conductor/busbar entry apertures are grouped under each shared terminal. No PE, shield, communication or auxiliary terminal is part of this order; separate accessory equipment is excluded.

1.description: Marked terminal 1, protected pole 1; shared conductor/busbar terminal

3.description: Marked terminal 3, protected pole 2; shared conductor/busbar terminal

4.description: Marked terminal 4, protected pole 2; shared conductor/busbar terminal
